\item \textit{Notes:} Time-pooled means of AGI migration rates (\% of county base population) for the IRS and ACS SDID samples, averaged over in-sample years (2020 excluded). Panels~B--D restrict to the balanced ACS panel (IRS-389, ACS-25+, and ACS-college estimation samples): of the 389 ACS-identified counties, 337 (336 donors $+$ Multnomah) survive the balanced-panel and state-drop restrictions. See Appendix~\ref{sec:appendixb} for donor-pool construction (including the narrow similar-cities pool) and Appendix~\ref{sec:appb_college} for the college subsample.
\item Source: IRS SOI county-to-county migration flows (Panels~A and~B); ACS microdata, all 25+ (Panel~C) and college-educated (Panel~D) subsamples.
